transcripts.question: Which setting is the score gap within which cheaper strategies win?
transcripts.answer: **Strategy selection**: every strategy gets a score from the category evidence; among strategies within `cost_tolerance` (default 0.1) of the best, the **cheapest** wins (`STRATEGY_COST`: exact 1 … multistage 10). A challenger can never win by being cheaper while less accurate, so self-optimisation cannot silently reduce accuracy. Scores from different retrievers are not comparable, so rank-based fusion is right, but weights and retriever sets must be configurable and entity/identifier retrieval is missing.
cited: docs/ADR/0005-configurable-rank-fusion.md > ADR-0005: Configurable weighted RRF with entity and exact-value retrievers

transcripts.question: Which setting sets the minimum labelled outcomes before a learned routing override applies?
transcripts.answer: When enabled, a learned override replaces the default strategy only if **all** hold (`routing/learning.py`): - both strategies have ≥ `learning_min_samples` (20) labelled outcomes in that category; - the challenger's Wilson 95% **lower** bound ≥ the default's observed accuracy; Low route confidence (< 0.25) promotes `hybrid` and optionally consults a model classifier (`ChatProvider`; output validated against the label set; failures ignored).

transcripts.question: Which Prometheus metric tracks recall latency?
transcripts.answer: Metrics: accuracy (exact-match containment) with 95% bootstrap CI (1000 resamples, fixed seed), Recall@5, Precision@5, MRR, nDCG@5 over *source-event ids* of returned evidence, evidence coverage (a relevant source is among returned evidence), unsupported-answer rate, false-abstain rate, contradiction-detection accuracy, citation exactness (top evidence is the right note and its excerpt contains the answer), temporal accuracy by case, context tokens (≈ 4 chars/token estimate of returned evidence), retrieval latency (p50/p95), update cost (ms/event), storage ÷ raw text, restart time. Providers support timeouts, retries with backoff and `Retry-After`, fallback chains, availability checks (`OllamaEmbedder.is_available()`), and token/cost tracking via `usage_sink=memory.record_usage`.
